actions.name: Gravity Pulse
actions.description: As a standard action, the mech jolts the gravity in a 10-, 20-, or 30-ft. emanation from the edges of its space. Other creatures in the area are flat-footed until the start of the mech's next turn unless they succeed at a Reflex save (DC 12 + ½ the mech's tier). A creature that fails by 5 or more also falls prone.
